prompt:
Create a NEW KFB claymation ink-blob sheet using the two attached original benchmarks solely for anatomy, clay surface, and sculpted eyes. Exactly six complete independent footless characters in three columns by two rows. Landscape 1536×1024 PNG. TRUE transparent alpha-zero background in all gaps and margins. No white matte, floor, vignette, scenery, large backdrop screens, shadow discs, labels, grid lines, real organization logos or national badges. Reactor Incident crew. Shared kit: burnt-orange helmet shells, dark graphite collar rings, pale ivory ceramic buckles and metallic amber equipment, industrial retro clay. Top row Survey Detail, bottom row Control Detail. Each blob is a separate character with a full standalone silhouette at comparable scale. Art direction: richly tactile dark charcoal-plum satin clay with soft highlights, round organic goo bodies and short goo hands. Equipment rests directly against the clay body with chunky rounded shapes. Keep each full face unobstructed, including white ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, dark sculpted lids and dark ink lips. Protective hoods have wide open face rings or a clear visor raised above the forehead. Two subtly female-read figures in cells 2 and 5. Mouth and body silhouette vary deliberately. Teeth sit within an open mouth. No human torso, legs, boots or rigid armor. Props: a Hypernormalization Screen is a little portable slab the character holds beside its body, with dark smoked glass and a chunky rim. A dangerous card is a sealed abstract blank card with one tiny dark corner mark. No lettering. Keep all silhouettes including droplets and equipment in their cells, with generous air around each. Row-major direction:
1. Male-read somber radiation surveyor. small analog survey meter with blank dial ticks. wide square body with steady narrowed gaze.
2. Female-read sharply alert instrument reader. short tethered probe held down along the flank. slim pear blob with asymmetrical eyes and a tight mouth.
3. Male-read nervously thorough perimeter marker. tiny amber warning beacon with broad base, unlit. round scalloped blob with a small tense gasp.
4. Male-read firmly patient equipment custodian. compact round valve wheel carried at belly. broad squat blob, low eyebrows and dry closed smile.
5. Female-read intently focused screen technician. small orange-framed Hypernormalization Screen with dark graphite glass and one dull amber lamp. tall comma blob, raised brow and narrow mouth.
6. Male-read quietly determined incident liaison. short graphite radio with ceramic knob. rounded pear blob, steady side glance and dark pout.
Make the theme readable at thumbnail size. Render all six as independent character cutouts with true alpha.
